newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 26.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
** The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 3.33 points at 5,877.36 on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve decided to hold interest rates steady.
** The capital market supervisory agency (Bapepam) is investigating a large block sale of Astra shares on Tuesday which involved a stake of around five percent in the vehicle manufacturer.

** The Jakarta Composite Index rose 2.52 points, or 0.44 percent, to close at 572.29 points on Wednesday on the back of strong rises in selected blue-chips, with the focus on the country's largest vehicle manufacturer Astra International.
** On Thursday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,319.50/20.00 in early trade against an opening of 2,319.00/20.00.
** Cocoa processor Cahaya Kalbar on market talk that the firm had planned a large expansion programme which was expected to boost earnings.
** Astra on news that tobacco tycoon Putra Sampoerna is at least partly involved in the wave of buying into the company.
** Bank NISP on announcement of a stock split to 500 rupiah per share from 1,000 previously.
** Berlian Laju Tanker on an announcement that the shipping firm had bought a 20 percent stake worth $1,433,788 in Malaysia's Merchant Marine Sdn Bhd.
